log:
marta: T-3m to the change window. Quick readiness sweep — smoke + canary config + rollback thresholds. Release notes posted: https://internal.releases/redwood/notes/1.4.2

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy queued by @marta. Start: 2026-03-21T15:00:00Z. Canary: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> full. Pin set: v3.4.1 -> v3.4.2. Auto-fallback enabled.

alex: staging smoke green. gen/embeddings p95 ~110ms, p99 ~170ms, error-rate 0.08% (baseline 0.12%). Logs look clean.

ashley: Observability: dashboards ready, synthetic checks passing (trend-dashboard). Alerting: notify @oncall-bg at 5xx > 0.5% or p99 latency spike +30%. I'll be watching.

marta: Rollback thresholds we agreed: 5xx/error > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p99 latency +30% sustained 5m, or revenue path errors. If threshold hit — immediate rollback.

oncall-bg: I'll call rollback and run the rollback playbook if thresholds hit. Owners:
- oncall-bg: rollback exec
- alex: logs/traces
- ashley: alerts/dashboards
- release-manager: customer comms

deploy-bot: Canary policy: if canary error-rate > 0.4% for 2 consecutive windows, pause and notify channel. Auto-rollback disabled for canary-only errors (manual decision required).

alex: quick note — I pushed a canary-specific log filter to reduce noise. If you see a spike, look for the kvcache WARN spam (expected transient during first prefixes).

marta: Communications: release-manager will post release notes + support blurb after full rollout. For rollback we will send an interim note to affected customers.

release-manager: Got it. Release highlights in RN: embeddings perf improvement, kv-cache refactor, fixed mistagging in reranker. No DB schema changes. Post-deploy checklist: update ops runbook, tag build in registry, create telemetry checkpoint.

ashley: Locking pins now -> please don't change pin status unless emergency. @deploy-bot lock-pins

deploy-bot: Pins locked by @ashley. No manual unpin allowed without 2 approvals (release-manager + oncall-bg).

marta: Final thumbs? If no objections I will trigger deploy at T0.

alex: :thumbsup:
ashley: +1
release-manager: :thumbsup:
oncall-bg: Ready, will monitor

marta: OK starting deploy in 30s, I'll post updates every step. If anyone sees anything noisy, call it out fast.

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Phase: canary (5%). Canary window: 10m. Notifying SLO guardrails.

marta: Smoke watch: verify /health, quick sample of chat generation, and embedding similarity checks (small prompt set).

alex: First 2 mins canary: errors 0.09%, p99 175ms. Slight rise but within threshold. Continuing.

ashley: Traces show a small tail on long sequences, but no error clusters. Dashboards stable.

oncall-bg: Setting alerting to high-sensitivity for the next 15m. If 5xx crosses 0.5% I'll escalate.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 25% at +10m automatically.

marta: Monitoring 10-25% warmup. Keep eyes on redis kvcache connection counts — last change touched timeouts.

alex: kvcache connections spike at rollout start but drop after TTL warmup. All good so far.

release-manager: Preparing post-canary announcement draft in #marketing-drafts. Will hold until full.

marta: If any of these triggers happen, preferred rollback command:
```/deploy rollback --to v3.4.1 --reason "canary threshold breach"```
I'll also ping exec if we escalate.

ashley: Copy. Also remember manual unpin command:
```/deploy unpin v3.4.2 --by @release-manager```

oncall-bg: If I call rollback I'll run the rollback playbook step-by-step and post timestamps here. Team will not reattempt until postmortem cleared.

deploy-bot: Full rollout completed. Status: success. All regions: green. Pins remain locked.

marta: Great work everyone — closing the change window. Release-manager, please publish notes + customer comms. I'll open a post-deploy mini-retro tomorrow.

release-manager: Will publish now. Post-deploy checklist done: registry tag + telemetry checkpoint.

alex: Quick follow-up item: monitor p99 over next 24h for any regression from kvcache warm starts.
